method: iam simulate-principal-policy, ONE --resource-arns per invocation (several in one call flip the held ones to implicitDeny)

same_principal_positive_control.why: the role's pre-existing grant; it rules out the simulator's false-DENY modes on this exact principal and action, and shows this act did not disturb the portal read

bucket_exists_read: s3api head-bucket opal-data-harvest rc=0 (the false-ALLOW mode's guard: an allowed against a non-existent resource proves only that the pattern matches the string)

before_this_act.note: measured in Phase A, before the grant existed
